stem: The reader can infer that Mole and Thomas built a tower for each photo because —

options.label: F
options.text: Mole needed all the soldiers to be able to look at the camera

options.label: G
options.text: the view from the ground did not provide the correct perspective for the photograph

options.label: H
options.text: Mole wanted to be able to see when participants were having difficulty standing still

options.label: J
options.text: the view from the ground made it difficult to select the participants needed for the photograph
